context_note: All four quarterfinals are now played. Two days off before the semis (Tue/Wed). Argentina vs Croatia and France vs Morocco set as the SF pairings.

yesterday_matches.headline: Morocco become first African nation in a World Cup semifinal

scorers.note: headed in over a stranded Diogo Costa, who came for a ball he had no business attacking

lineups.Morocco: Bono · Hakimi, Aguerd, Saïss (off 57'), Mazraoui · Amrabat, Ounahi, Amallah (off 65') · Ziyech, En-Nesyri (off 82'), Boufal
lineups.Portugal: Diogo Costa · Diogo Dalot, Rúben Dias, Pepe, Raphaël Guerreiro · Rúben Neves, Bernardo Silva, William Carvalho · Bruno Fernandes, Gonçalo Ramos (off 51', for Ronaldo), João Félix

key_facts: Cristiano Ronaldo entered as a 51st-minute substitute in what would prove to be his final World Cup appearance.
Walid Regragui took over as Morocco's manager in late August 2022, three months before the tournament began.
Morocco have not conceded a goal from open play in this tournament. The only goal scored against them was an own-goal vs Canada.
Crowd was visibly majority-Moroccan; Doha's Moroccan diaspora and travelling support filled the stadium.
narrative_threads: Probable Ronaldo international farewell — he wept on the way back to the tunnel.
Morocco's defensive structure (Saïss carried off injured; Aguerd held it together) absorbed enormous pressure.

yesterday_matches.headline: Kane misses the equaliser from the spot; France advance to the semis

scorers.note: low driven shot from outside the box, deflected slightly off Maguire

key_moments: England missed a second penalty in the 84th minute — Kane skied it over the bar after Mason Mount was fouled by Théo Hernandez.
Saka was a constant menace down the right but ran into a determined Théo Hernandez performance.
Mbappé was quiet by his standards — no goals, no assists — but his runs pulled England's back line out of shape repeatedly.
narrative_threads: Bellingham vs Tchouaméni was the midfield battle of the tournament — both 19, both magnificent.
Kane's missed penalty: his first competitive miss for England since 2018. Visibly distraught.
Southgate's England eliminated at the QFs again. Pattern.

two_days_ago_matches.headline: Croatia knock out the favourites again — Brazil out on penalties
narrative_threads: Croatia knock out a tournament favourite on penalties for the third tournament in a row.
Tite resigns immediately after; his post-match presser is one paragraph long.
Neymar matched Pelé's all-time Brazil scoring record (77 goals) with his goal.

two_days_ago_matches.headline: Messi-Van Gaal feud explodes; Argentina survive a chaotic finish

scorers.note: Messi assist, one of the great World Cup through-balls
free-kick routine — clipped through the wall by Koopmeiners

narrative_threads: Eleven minutes of injury time, eighteen yellow cards (a World Cup record), and a brawl at the final whistle.
Messi confronts Van Gaal post-match (the 'qué mirás, bobo' moment that lives on Twitter forever).
Emiliano Martínez saves two of the four Dutch penalties; Argentina through.

today_fixtures.note: Off day. No matches. Semis begin Tuesday.
